title: Sukha Singh Slays Karma Chhina; Amritsar Restrictions Begin

blocks.text: The duel with Karma Chhina ends swiftly once terms are fixed. Sukha Singh allows the first attack, absorbs the spear-thrust, and answers with a clean sword-stroke that kills his opponent and finishes the fort episode.

The narrative then pivots into a fresh crisis centered on Amritsar. A new Mughal policy emerges in which the Mughals forbid Sikhs to bathe at Amritsar, turning access to the sacred pool into a test of power and submission.

This makes the page a hinge between two episodes. It closes one tale of personal combat and opens another in which the Khalsa must answer public taunts and state restriction around the central shrine itself.
